title: Zoning text change for 289 Kent Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This resolution approves, with modifications, a zoning text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 289 Kent Avenue in Williamsburg, Brooklyn. Combined with a related zoning map change, it would allow an 18-story mixed-use building with 278 apartments, including 56 to 83 permanently income-restricted units, plus about 29,300 square feet of ground floor commercial space. The Council held a public hearing on September 9, 2026 before approving the measure on October 8, 2026.
